verdict.rationale: The only concrete evidence of processing 'many items at once' is the Store Sync catalog feed upload, where a single feed file (CSV/TSV/PSV, up to 4GB) can contain many product rows/variants for bulk catalog ingestion. Outside of catalog upload, the agent toolkit's tools (create_order, create_refund, get_dispute, create_product) are documented as single-item operations with no batch/bulk endpoints for orders, refunds, or disputes. missing for 10: evidence of bulk/batch APIs for orders, refunds, or disputes; any documented multi-item transaction or batch-processing tool beyond catalog feed upload.
